fields.name: SqlParameters typed SQL parameter materialization
fields.contract: SqlParameters extends a DbParameterCollection with a single family for scalar input/output and structured input parameters. Every member appends exactly one SqlParameter to the supplied collection and returns that same collection. The family normalizes a parameter name by adding `@` when absent; its known dimensions are direction (Input or Output), SQL type, nullability, and type-specific size/locale or precision/scale metadata. Structured members accept SqlDataRecord sequences, model sequences, keyed-model sequences, or ShardKey sequences and append an Input parameter of type Structured.
